meta.title: Safwa Broast | Broast from Al Qafilah, Khamis Mushait. App coming soon
meta.description: Safwa Broast in Al Qafilah, Khamis Mushait. Our app for iPhone and Android is coming soon, so you can order ahead and track your delivery to the door.

hero.subtitle: Our app is nearly ready. You'll order from the Al Qafilah kitchen on your phone and track the driver to your door.
hero.photoAlt: A pile of golden fried broast chicken

tracking.title: Watch it come to you.
tracking.body: The app shows where your order is at every stage, from the fryer in Al Qafilah to your door, so you won't need to call and ask.

steps.title: On the way
steps.body: You can follow the driver on the map.

steps.title: Arrived
steps.body: The driver is at your door.

tracking.screenAlt: Live tracking in the Safwa app: order #AS-8821 is on the way, with the driver on the map, 12 minutes left and the driver's details.

extras.title: It remembers how you order.
extras.body: Save your address and payment method once. Next time, your usual order is one tap away.
extras.screenAlt: Home screen of the Safwa app with food categories and the Family Broast Meal offer

footer.ctaBody: The app is coming to iPhone and Android soon. Until then, come and see us in Al Qafilah.
footer.tagline: Broast, burgers and pizza in Al Qafilah, Khamis Mushait.
footer.address: Opp. Husam Medical Clinic, Nasr Addin Al Tusi Street, Al Qafilah, Khamis Mushait
